# stalwart_mta_delivery_schedule (Data Source)

Defines retry and notification intervals for message delivery.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Short identifier for the schedule

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A short description of the schedule, which can be used to identify it in the list of schedules
- `expiry` (Attributes) Whether to expire messages after a number of delivery attempts or after certain time (TTL) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--expiry))
- `notify` (Attributes) List of delayed delivery DSN notification intervals (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notify))
- `queue_id` (String) The name of the virtual queue to use for this schedule
- `retry` (Attributes) List of retry intervals for message delivery (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retry))

<a id="nestedatt--expiry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `expiry`

Read-Only:

- `expire` (Number) Time after which the message will be expired if it is not delivered
- `max_attempts` (Number) Maximum number of delivery attempts before the message is considered failed
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.


<a id="nestedatt--notify"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notify`

Read-Only:

- `intervals` (Attributes List) List of intervals (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notify--intervals))
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

<a id="nestedatt--notify--intervals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notify.intervals`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (Number) Time interval for retries or notifications



<a id="nestedatt--retry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry`

Read-Only:

- `intervals` (Attributes List) List of intervals (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retry--intervals))
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

<a id="nestedatt--retry--intervals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry.intervals`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (Number) Time interval for retries or notifications
